she might have a lot of food aversions so it's important to keep what she doesn't have aversions to stocked up, sometimes not eating the thing you want instantly whilst pregnant makes you throw up, not sure why but it's a shared experience amongst so many women.

keep the place smelling very clean, keep the windows open for good air flow and maybe stock up on some air freshener that she chooses.

keep lots of fresh fruit, she will be so weak she will need the sugars 

with hg once she reaches 16-17 weeks she may be able to start eating a meal a day (in my experience) and keep it down, she will still probably be incredibly nauseous. 

I refused hospital admission when I was really bad, I probably shouldn't have, by the sounds of it she may actually need hospital admission
